components.gap: Rules, side conditions and adequacy: the tableau row of tab:p02-fol-proof-systems (first-order-calculi-supplement.tex:236-244) compares only the equality-free base calculus T. It omits the registered identity extension T^= of sheet:tableaux-fol: its rules (=refl, =repl; tableaux-fol.tex:27-28, def:p02-w02-p02-014-fol-equality), their side conditions (closed L*_Gamma-terms; atomic phi with x_0 occurring exactly once; each triple used once per branch; fairness over every reflexivity and replacement task, so no finite T^= branch is saturated) and its adequacy theorems for roots with equality (thm:p02-w02-p02-014-fol-soundness, -extraction, -completeness, -semidecision). The row gives its scope as 'Equality-free; sheet:tableaux-fol' although that sheet now also registers T^= with proved adequacy (tableaux-fol.tex:15), and it cites -semidecision, which covers T^=, without saying so. The table therefore does not compare tableaux for FOL on all their rules, side conditions and adequacy theorems, whereas the ND and LK rows include their identity rules. Supply the T^= rules, side conditions and adequacy in the tableau row (or an explicitly separate identity-tableau row) and correct its scope entry.
